https://www.playstation.com/games/crimson-desert

From new stories, ocean exploration, and more content to enrich your life in Pywel, get a closer look at what new adventures await in Crimson Desert Enhanced's DLC Charting the Unknown with this Features Overview video.

Charting the Unknown arrives on PlayStation 5 on October 29 GMT/PDT. Pre-order now to receive the exclusive "Charter's and Charter's Light Diving Sets" pre-order bonus and prepare to reach beyond—into the unknown.

About Crimson Desert
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent. The Greymane Kliff is determined to reunite with his surviving comrades and rebuild what was lost. But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff comes to realize that an unprecedented threat and a destiny greater than he imagined await him.

text:
The Wolf Among Us Remastered - Story Trailer | PS5 Games
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/the-wolf-among-us-remastered/

A murder in Fabletown. A sheriff with a dark past. Bigby Wolf's first case pulls him deeper into a conspiracy, and the closer he gets to the truth, the harder it is to keep the wolf in check. Watch the story unfold, then get the first look at Bigby's redesigned werewolf form.

The Wolf Among Us Remastered is the definitive edition of Telltale's acclaimed detective thriller, with enhanced visuals, upgraded animation and audio, an all-new Noir Mode, behind-the-scenes bonus content, and for the first time, playable deleted scenes restored from the original 2013 production.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown.  Myths and legends live secretly among us and every choice carries consequences. 
Fairytales are real. Murder is just the beginning.

Available October 29, 2026.

text:
NTE - Akane Rin: V1.4 Character Trailer | PS5 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/nte-neverness-to-everness/

The second half of NTE V1.4 "For Whom the Verses Mourn" kicks off October 21, and new S-class character Akane Rin makes her debut. Collab track "God Knows... (NTE Cover Ver.)" drops the same day!

With hair as golden as the sun, Akane seems made for the spotlight. Yet she's usually tucked away in a quiet corner far from the crowd, headphones on, lost in her own music. But sooner or later, someone comes looking for her, slips those headphones off, and pulls her back into the noise of the real world.

Jump in now to meet Akane. Listen to one of her favorite songs together, then head out for a walk!
